purpose: Add a pinned, fully offline mcp-ssh-manager stdio Toolpack with all 37 tools, conversational connection administration, bundled native SSH utilities, and trust-on-first-use host-key verification.
offlineRuntime: All production Node.js dependencies are included under node_modules.
rsync, sshpass, OpenSSH client tools, and required shared libraries are included under runtime.
No npm, pnpm, npx, apt, git, or network access is required at deployment time.
localAdaptations: Enable all 37 upstream tools by default.
Allow unrestricted, readonly, and restricted per-server modes; default to unrestricted.
Manage structured SSH and database connection profiles through deterministic local scripts and a CowAgent Skill.
Accept and record first-seen host keys, reject changed keys, and support explicit re-trust.
Store runtime credentials outside the patch artifact with mode 600.
